integrity: Analytical proof plus exact finite diagnostics; finite tests are not exhaustive or a proof of the limit. No independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: For periodic binary rule 128, fixed p>=1 and N>=3; weighted initial states entering the fixed set within p steps. The finite-size limit holds for p fixed, not in a joint growth regime. Equivalent earlier specializations remain possible.
title: Exact all-transient coexistence threshold and finite-size crossover for rule-128 trajectories
